{
  "dataset_name": "click_prediction_small",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "position_depth_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Relative position of the ad within the result list depth. Lower values indicate top placement.",
      "value_range": [0.33, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous signal of ad prominence useful for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "position / depth"
    },
    {
      "name": "position_from_bottom",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Number of slots from the bottom of the displayed list; higher means more prominent.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear ordinal signal of ad visibility.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "depth - position"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_top_position",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the ad is shown in the top position slot.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Sharp linear feature capturing top-slot prominence effect.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(position == 1, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_position_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized position score scaled to [0,1] where 1 indicates the bottom of the list.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized severity ideal for SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(position - 1.0) / np.maximum(depth - 1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_impression",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed impression count to compress heavy-tailed distribution.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.61],
      "feature_family": "log_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes skewed impression counts for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(impression)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_keyword_id",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled keyword identifier as a smooth proxy for keyword rarity ordering.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.01],
      "feature_family": "log_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth proxy of keyword space for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(keyword_id)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_user_id",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled user identifier to compress wide ID range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 17.0],
      "feature_family": "log_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides bounded continuous proxy for user-id grouping.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(user_id)"
    },
    {
      "name": "has_description",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the ad has a non-missing description id.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Binary content-completeness signal useful in linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(description_id > 0, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_description_consistency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smooth similarity between log-scaled title and description ids, capturing co-occurrence pattern.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 17.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Approximates linear interaction between title and description identifiers.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(np.log1p(title_id) - np.log1p(description_id))"
    },
    {
      "name": "ad_advertiser_scale",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of log ad_id and log advertiser_id capturing scale of advertising entity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth composite providing linear projection of ad-entity scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.5 * np.log1p(ad_id) + 0.5 * np.log1p(advertiser_id)"
    },
    {
      "name": "impression_per_slot",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Impressions normalized by depth, a smooth measure of exposure density.",
      "value_range": [0.33, 5467.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous severity score of exposure intensity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "impression / depth"
    },
    {
      "name": "ad_content_richness_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of ad content richness based on presence and magnitude of keyword, title, and description identifiers, scaled to [0,1].",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides bounded interpretable richness signal complementing linear features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
